name: FLUX.3 Klein distilled — fast text to image
title: Make a picture in seconds
summary: Write a detailed description and get a high-quality picture — the fastest picture card, light enough to share the computer with another card. It can also place things where you draw boxes.
description: Generate an image from a text prompt with Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Image Klein, distilled build: 16 steps and no guidance, so it is the quick one. Write full sentences: subject, action, setting, light, style; put any text to render in "quotes". FLUX.3 is trained on long, detailed captions. Its AI improver (a Qwen 3.5 model that writes that caption for you) fails on this ComfyUI build with "Unsupported Flash Attention tensor strides", so leave it off and write the caption yourself: the medium first, then the scene, the light, the camera, and where each subject sits. To place things, draw boxes in the layout and cite them as <obj_1>, <obj_2>… in the prompt.
author: Template - ComfyUI (FLUX.3 Image Klein)

exposedParameters.label: Prompt
exposedParameters.default: A cinematic, Dutch angle night shot of a retro hotel entrance illuminated by neon cyan and warm orange lights. A bellhop in uniform pulls a gold luggage cart with suitcases across a wet sidewalk. Inside the brightly lit, teal-toned glass lobby, two women in vintage uniforms stand near a wooden desk alongside tropical plants and a seated figure. The scene features a moody, stylized teal-and-orange color palette with strong neon reflections. Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.

exposedParameters.label: Layout — optional boxes (use Compose layout; cite box N in the prompt as <obj_N>)

Improve the prompt with AI first (a Qwen 3.5 model expands it into a full caption) — slow: adds about 3 minutes ⚠ currently fails on this ComfyUI build (0.43.2: "Unsupported Flash Attention tensor strides" in the Qwen 3.5 decode) — leave it off
